description: This file defines a React functional component 'MCPServerSelector', which provides a user interface for selecting MCP servers and access groups. It fetches data from networking APIs, displays options in a multi-select dropdown, and manages selection state with callback support.

methods.name: MCPServerSelector
methods.description: React functional component for selecting MCP servers and access groups, managing data fetching and selection.
